texts.text: 畢業規則先看「入學年度＋班別」
這份指南以日間四技在校生為主。一般班、技優班與不同入學年度可能不同；申請資格和日期請以各處室當期公告為準。
標籤依查找需求分類，申請資格仍以各項公告為準。
先對自己的入學年度與班別。學分、必修、英文、證照、實習與專題，都要分開確認。
不同入學年與班別分開核對；有缺項就找系辦確認補修或認列。
找到自己的入學年度課表
從教務處歷年課程表找到「動遊系」，先核對入學年與一般班、技優班。把自己的那一份存下來，之後選課與畢業檢核都用它比對。
對照系統畢業檢核，列出缺項
從校務資訊的「教務系統 → 查詢程式 → 畢業學分檢核表查詢」查看，將未通過的課程、英文、證照、實習與專題分開列出。先確認系統資料計算到哪一學期，連零學分必修一起核對，不只看總學分。
帶檢核結果找系辦確認補修或認列
找系辦時一起帶入學年課表、成績與未通過項目的畫面，直接問缺課要補哪門、已有證明如何認列。若涉及抵免或學籍，再請註冊課務組協助確認。
技優班條件另核，請帶自己的入學年度課表向系辦確認。

先確認工作內容能否認列，再處理指導、合約與保險，避免做完才發現不算實習。
這是開始實習前的準備；實習中怎麼聯絡老師、結束後交什麼，也請先問清楚。
先向系辦取得當期實習規定
先向系辦說明自己的入學年、班別與預計實習期間，索取適用的辦法及申請表。也一起問時數怎麼算、結束後要交什麼，避免只知道最低時數。
確認單位、工作內容與指導老師
把公司名稱、職務說明、預計做的事與工作期間整理給系辦或指導老師看。自找公司或原本的打工能否認列，要先確認，不能做完才補問。
完成合約及保險確認後，再依規定開始
請實習承辦確認合約由誰簽、保險何時生效，以及出了問題要找誰。拿到需補文件的清單後再安排開始日期，不把公司口頭答應當成學校程序完成。
自找公司、打工時數認列或中止實習，請先向系辦確認適用規定。

證照能否算畢業門檻，要先對系上清單；認列與獎助金是兩件事，考過後仍要查申請流程。
畢業認列與獎助是兩件事；獎助須另查當期資格及期限。
考照前先問系辦是否認列
把證照全名、發照單位與預計考取版本交給系辦，問是否適用自己的入學年與班別。先確認能認列，再安排報名與費用，別只看別人考過哪一張。
取得證明後完成認列登錄
準備清楚的證照或成績證明，先核對姓名、證照名稱與生效日期。再向系辦確認登錄位置、是否另交文件，以及畢業檢核何時可查到結果。
另向職發中心查獎助資格並送件
先向職發中心確認當期獎助資格，並檢查本人匯款帳戶資料是否已交出納組。若老師已團體登錄證照，仍要確認是否需要另外追加獎助申請。
技優班條件另核；畢業認列與獎助資格，請分別向系辦、職發中心確認。

有考試、較長假期或緊急狀況，先向承辦確認另外要辦的事。
確認假別、日期與需要的證明
先整理不能到課的日期、節次與原因，再向導師或生輔組確認假別及證明。遇到考試、心理假或較長期間，先問清楚是否還有其他辦理方式。

送件後回到系統查看是否核准；沒有回覆時，主動找導師追蹤。若會影響考試或需請長假，再向導師與註冊課務組確認後續，別把送出當核准。

先看校務系統的正式課表。必修、衝堂與學分數都要自己確認，上過課不等於已完成加選。
選課成功與課程異動都要再查；已截止的時程不代表仍可補選。
對照必修、學分數與上課時間
把入學年課表與本學期系統課表並排，先看必修是否漏選，再檢查學分與衝堂。若有抵免、重修或補修，另外列出來，選課前一起問系辦。
依當期公告辦理初選或加退選
到教務處確認現在屬於初選、加退選還是棄選，再依該階段公告辦理。過去的加退選日期不能繼續使用；遇到逾期或特殊情況，先問註冊課務組。
重開系統確認結果，有問題找註冊課務組
操作後重新開啟系統課表，確認課名、班別與時間真的正確。若和預期不同，記下課程代碼及問題畫面找註冊課務組，不以出席或老師同意代替系統結果。

修過類似課程不等於自動抵免。準備原始成績與申請表，依開課單位、系所及教務處順序審核。
先核對可申請身分與當期期限；初審後的加退選要自己辦，不等最後核定才處理。
到系統填寫申請並印出紙本
先確認申請身分與當期截止日，再到校務系統填寫並印表。備妥原校歷年成績單正本及適用的證明，一次整理齊全。
送請開課單位與就讀系所主管初審
把申請資料交給開課單位與自己就讀的系所主管審查。哪些課程可以抵免，先依這個初審結果確認。
依初審結果自行辦理加退選
初審通過的課程如果仍在課表裡，要自行處理退選；也一起確認需要補選哪些課。不要等最後核定後才開始處理。
將申請表及證明交註冊課務組
依規定把經初審的申請表與證明資料交到教務處註冊課務組。資料請一次備齊，送件仍須在當期受理期間內完成。

入學前考的證照也有獎助嗎？
已核對的114-2公告不補助入學前證照；能否作本系畢業認列仍須對清單。當期獎助資格請洽職發中心1713。
老師已幫我登錄，還要申請獎助嗎？
114-2公告將證照登錄與獎助申請分開，團體登錄後仍可能要追加申請。公告列證照生效半年內；請先問1713自己的案件適用期限。
送出後一直沒回覆，可以當作准假嗎？
不能；要以系統最後核准結果為準。若一直沒有回覆，主動找導師追蹤，別把假單送出當成核准。

老師同意、也去上課，就算選到了嗎？
仍要以校務系統的選課紀錄為準，請核對課程是否確實列入自己的課表。
這學期還能直接加退選嗎？
已核對的115-1加退選於2026/9/14上午9時截止，現在不能當作仍開放。棄選或特殊情況是否可辦，請查當期公告並洽註冊課務組。
不想修了，直接不上課就算退選嗎？
不算。請依當期開放的程序辦理退選或棄選，完成後再查正式課表；未完成程序仍依規定評量。114年2月19日選課準則另列棄選條件與學分限制，本期受理日期仍要看公告。

英文分級免修，學分就不用補了嗎？
通識中心修課頁說明，分級後免修的課程學分仍須用認列的專業外語補足；日四技英文與外語合計8學分，請按入學年度核對。

先向語文承辦確認自己適用的測驗、分數、證明效期與替代方案，再決定報考，不直接套用別校或往年資訊。

教務處FAQ說明，休學期滿前會寄送復學通知，應依通知辦理。地址、信箱與電話有變動要更新；兵役問題另向生輔組確認。

一般申訴與性平可以共用同一張表嗎？
不要先假設表單共用。請導師協助找對承辦，確認案件類型、受理方式與期限後，再使用對應表單。
還沒畢業，也可以先做職涯準備嗎？
職發中心職掌列有學生職涯規劃、UCAN職能檢測、講座與就業輔導；可先洽中心確認當期可使用的資源。
徵才活動或職缺一定每學期都一樣嗎？
不一定。中心辦理就業相關活動，但實際日期與職缺要看當期公告；不要直接沿用過往海報的報名連結。
應屆生還沒拿到畢業證書，能報本校116碩甄嗎？
116簡章允許115學年度應屆畢業生依規定報考，須交附表一並經教務單位核章；錄取後仍須取得學士資格才能註冊。

Turn the page and meet us
★ MOE overseas internship program · HC, Matsuyama, Ehime
Design goes global: our ninth Japan internship cohort

Under the Ministry of Education’s 學海築夢 overseas internship program, four students joined hautecouture Inc. (HC) in Matsuyama, Ehime, Japan for nearly three months. Led by 張純雅, the group also took part in exchanges on regional revitalization and traditional crafts in Seiyo and Tobe.

Obsessive Reality (《癡迷的現實》) Adds 5 More International Film Festivals · Reaching 13 Across 7 Countries

News of nominations and selections from film festivals in Dubai, Chicago, Shivaji, Tokyo and Italy came in the same month — the animated short film Obsessive Reality (《癡迷的現實》), advised by Chen Mei-rong (陳美蓉), has accumulated 13 international nominations and official selections.
AGD capstone Dear, All Robots featured in international media

Advised by Chen Mei-rong (陳美蓉), an Indonesian student team participated in the 2026 Youth Innovative Design Festival (青春設計節) with their graduation animated short Dear, All Robots (《Dear, All Robots》), receiving dedicated feature reports from CommonWealth English and Crossing (《換日線 Crossing》).
AGD 2026 Competition Honors List · 14 Shortlist Places with 7 Graduation Projects on the Board

National Practical Project Competition for Technical Colleges and Universities, Youth Innovative Design Festival, Vision Get Wild and Young Pin Design Award — 14 shortlist places across four competitions, with the full results of seven capstone projects.
Four Student Animations Sweep International Film Festivals · 21+ Selections · Across 4 Continents of Europe, America, Asia, and Australia

《失竊的祕方》, 《癡迷的現實》, 《人造人》 and 《神癒》 reached competition sections at film festivals in several countries, earning honours including 「叛逆視野獎」 at Italy’s 「怪誕影展」 and the best fantasy category award at Spain’s 「愛情影展」.

Want to capture the attention of tens of thousands of anime and comic fans at once? Get priority consideration for recommendations to publishers in Taiwan and abroad, with a chance to become an online serial author.

SHU-TE DESIGN BUILDING · EXPLORE AGD LABS
A graphics-tablet classroom for practicing 2D character and environment design.
FDM / photopolymer resin 3D printer fleet, bringing 3D modeled creations into physical reality.
Virtual production studio: capture realistic scenes in real time without post-production and learn to link virtual and physical cameras.
VIVE tracking, treadmill, pneumatic platform and bicycle equipment for real-time testing of motion-controlled games.
A stop-motion studio combining physical model-making and hands-on, frame-by-frame animation.
3D printers, direct-printing equipment, heat transfer, laser cutting — end-to-end anime and game merchandise production.
A sports-and-technology innovation space for digital applications and outdoor sports experiences.
4 digital studios + 4 recording studios: broadcast anchors, voice actors, scoring, and 3D post-production all in one.
Digital technology and cultural creativity workshop: a maker-culture base for cross-disciplinary projects combining DIY and technology.
Multimedia and game/online media classrooms: from theory to development with game engines.
High-performance gaming computers and tournament-grade equipment for the esports industry program.
三創 (Creativity, Innovation and Entrepreneurship) Base: an incubator supporting student proposals, prototypes and venture development.
HC JAPAN · 9TH COHORT · 8 COMPANIES IN 3 COUNTRIES
The overseas internship program sent 22 students to Hautecouture in Matsuyama, Ehime over the past four years. Our network includes eight companies in Japan, Korea and Indonesia.
The Designer Studio course has invited over 20 independent designers to teach. The Hengshan Cup attracted over 600 high-school students and teachers nationwide.

For graduation rules, check "Admission Year + Program Type" first

This guide is mainly for students in the four-year undergraduate day program. Rules may differ by entry year and class, including regular classes and skills-excellence classes (技優班). Check the current notice from the responsible office for eligibility and dates.
Tags help you find topics; check each official notice for eligibility.
First check your academic entry year and class type. Credits, required courses, English proficiency, certifications, internships, and capstone project must all be verified separately.
Ask the department about make-up courses
Check the rules for your entry year and program. Ask the department about making up or recognizing anything missing.
Find the curriculum roadmap for your academic entry year

Find 'Department of Animation and Game Design' in the Office of Academic Affairs curriculum catalog across academic years, and check your enrollment year as well as regular class or skills-excellence class (技優班). Save your copy to reference later during course selection and graduation audits.
Cross-check with the system graduation audit to list missing requirements

In the university portal, open Academic Affairs → Queries → Graduation Credit Audit. List missing courses, English requirements, certificates, internships and capstone work separately. Check which semester the audit includes, and check required zero-credit courses as well as the credit total.
Bring the audit results to the department office to confirm makeup courses or credit recognition

When visiting the department office, bring your enrollment year curriculum, grades, and screenshots of unpassed items. Ask directly which course to take to make up for missing credits and how existing certificates can be recognized. If credit transfer or student status are involved, ask the Registration and Curriculum Division for assistance.

First confirm whether the job duties are eligible for credit recognition before handling faculty mentoring, contracts, and insurance, avoiding finding out after completion that it does not qualify as an internship.
These are preparations before starting an internship. Also ask how to contact your supervisor during it and what to submit afterward.
First obtain current internship regulations from the department office

First inform the department office of your enrollment year, class section, and expected internship period to obtain the applicable regulations and application forms. Also ask how hours are calculated and what must be submitted upon completion, rather than only knowing the minimum required hours.
Confirm the internship organization, job duties, and faculty advisor

Organize the company name, job description, planned tasks, and work period for the department office or your advisor to review. Confirm in advance whether self-found companies or existing part-time jobs can be recognized; do not wait until completion to ask.
Complete contract and insurance confirmations before starting according to regulations

Ask the internship coordinator to confirm who signs the contract, when insurance takes effect, and whom to contact if problems arise. Set the start date only after receiving the checklist of required supplementary documents; never treat a company's verbal agreement as completed school procedures.
For self-sourced companies, recognizing part-time work hours, or terminating an internship, please check applicable regulations with the department office first.

Whether a certification fulfills graduation requirements must first be checked against the department list; recognition toward graduation requirements and financial awards or subsidies are two separate matters, and application procedures must still be checked after passing.
Check and apply for certificate awards separately
Graduation recognition and awards are separate. Check the current eligibility and deadline for awards.
Ask the department office whether it is recognized before taking the certification exam

Submit the full certification title, issuing agency, and planned exam version to the department office to verify if it applies to your enrollment year and class section. Confirm it is eligible for recognition before arranging registration and payment; do not simply take a test because others passed it.
Complete recognition registration after obtaining the certificate

Prepare clear copies of your certificate or score transcript, checking your name, certificate title, and effective date first. Then confirm with the department office where to register it, whether additional documents are needed, and when the result will appear in the graduation audit.
Separately check subsidy eligibility with the Career Development Center and submit application

First check with the Career Development Center regarding current reward eligibility and ensure your remittance account details have been submitted to the Cashier Section. Even if an instructor registered the certification as a group, still confirm whether an additional reward application is required.

I Want to Apply for Leave
After submitting a leave application, follow up on approval results. Leave categories, days, and exam weeks may have different procedures; prepare supporting documents first before checking.
Check the leave type and evidence
If exams, extended leave or an emergency are involved, ask the responsible office about additional procedures.
Confirm leave type, dates, and required supporting documents

Organize the dates, class periods, and reasons for your absence, then verify the leave category and required proof with your class advisor or the Student Assistance Section. For exam periods, mental health leave, or extended absences, ask clearly in advance whether additional procedures apply.
Submit application in the university administration system

Log into the leave application service via the school's 'Current Students' portal, fill in the details in the system, and confirm submission. If you cannot find the required option, bring your screen to consult your advisor or the Student Assistance Section; do not assume notifying someone via messaging apps completes the process.
Track approvals; check with the coordinator if exams or extended leave are involved

After submitting, return to the system to verify whether it has been approved; if there is no response, follow up proactively with your advisor. If it affects exams or involves extended leave, consult your advisor and the Registration and Curriculum Division for follow-up steps; do not mistake submission for approval.
For exams, extended leave, or retroactive leave applications, check the procedure with your class advisor first; for exam handling, contact the Registration and Curriculum Division.

First check your official class schedule in the Academic Information System. You must confirm required courses, schedule conflicts, and credit totals yourself; attending a class does not mean you have completed the add process.
Register, add or drop as announced
Reopen the system to check the result
Recheck both registration and course changes. A past schedule does not mean late registration is still available.
Check required courses, credit totals, and class schedules

Place your enrollment year curriculum and this semester's system schedule side by side. Check first for any missed required courses, then verify total credits and timetable conflicts. If you have credit transfers, retaken courses, or makeup courses, list them separately and consult the department office before course selection.
Complete preliminary course selection or add/drop according to current announcements

Check with the Office of Academic Affairs whether the current period is preliminary registration, add/drop, or course withdrawal, and follow that stage's announcement. Past add/drop dates cannot be reused; if past deadlines or facing special circumstances, consult the Registration and Curriculum Division first.
Reopen the system to verify results; contact the Registration and Curriculum Division if any issues arise

After making changes, reopen your system schedule to verify that course titles, class sections, and times are indeed correct. If anything differs from expected, note the course code, take a screenshot of the issue, and contact the Registration and Curriculum Division; attending class or receiving instructor consent cannot substitute for official system records.

Having taken similar courses does not mean credits are automatically transferred. Prepare original transcripts and the application form for sequential review by the offering department, the degree program, and the Office of Academic Affairs.
Complete and print the online form
Adjust courses after the initial review
Submit documents to Registration and Curriculum Division
Check your eligibility and the current deadline first. Make course changes yourself after the initial review; do not wait for the final decision.
Complete the online application and print it

Check your eligibility and the current deadline, then complete and print the form in the university system. Prepare the original transcript from your previous institution and any applicable evidence together.
Request initial review by the course unit and your department heads
Submit your documents to the heads of the course-offering unit and your own department. Use the initial review to check which courses may receive credit.
Make course changes yourself based on the initial review
If a course approved at the initial review is still on your timetable, drop it yourself and check what you need to add. Do not wait for the final decision to start making changes.
Submit the form and evidence to Registration and Curriculum Division
Submit the initially reviewed form and evidence to Registration and Curriculum Division as required. Prepare all documents together and submit them within the current application period.
Return to the system to check the final decision
After submission, check the final decision in the university system and compare it with your timetable and graduation check. Bring any discrepancies to Registration and Curriculum Division.

Are international/overseas students guaranteed to receive Xuehai subsidies?

The current Ministry of Education guidelines require, among other conditions, Republic of China nationality, household registration in Taiwan and at least one semester of enrollment at the same level of study. Check internship participation and subsidy eligibility separately; past news does not establish eligibility.

Can I arrange my own insurance and visa for an overseas internship?

Ministry of Education guidelines require the university to assist with medical and accident insurance and legal internship visas during the internship. Please confirm according to program requirements and local regulations; do not assume that a tourist visa permits an internship. Subsidies are subject to the approved contract.
Ministry of Education Directions for Subsidizing Study Abroad or Overseas Professional Internships
Can Overseas study visits count directly toward internship hours or graduation credits?

It cannot be directly guaranteed. Visits, exchanges, and workplace internships differ in content; whether they can be recognized depends on current courses and department regulations. Please verify with the department office before registering.

texts.text: 申請後はシステムに戻って承認されたか確認してください。返信がない場合は担任に自主的に進捗を確認しましょう。試験に影響する場合や長期欠席となる場合は、担任および註冊課務組（学籍・履修担当）に今後の対応を確認し、申請しただけで承認されたと思い込まないようにしてください。

texts.text: 学科事務室で自分の学年に適用される卒業制作の実施規定を確認し、チーム編成、変更、審査、追試審査に関する書類を一度にまとめて確認してください。バージョンと適用対象を必ず事前に照合し、先輩から譲り受けたファイルをそのまま使わないようにしましょう。

texts.text: 作品の現在の完成度とタスクリストを指導教員に見せ、各審査で発表すべき内容を確認してください。その後、当該年度の案内に合わせて制作および書類整理のスケジュールを逆算して組み、修正のための余裕を持たせ、勝手に締め切りを推測しないようにしましょう。

texts.text: 提出前に、作品本体、説明資料、展示資料、許諾書がすべて必要かを教員に確認してもらい、指定フォーマットと項目ごとに照合してください。提出後は担当部署が受領したか、追加書類が必要かを確認し、作品を作り終えただけで手続きが完了したと思わないでください。

texts.text: 現在の状況に応じて休学または復学を手続きしてください。兵役対象者は生活指導担当に別途確認し、学籍手続きだけで兵役手続きも完了したと考えないでください。

texts.text: 指導教員または学科担当者と日程を調整し、註冊課務組（学籍・履修担当）で登録して用紙を受け取ってください。当期の公告に従い面談・離校手続き・書類返却を行います。用紙の受領日は返金額の計算に影響します。

"Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", Meiryo, "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif

texts.text: 復学・休学延長：通知に従い回答・手続き

texts.text: 復学通知を受け取ったら、指定期限までに復学または休学延長を回答し、次学期の登録手続きを確認してください。兵役に伴う休学・復学の場合は、必要な証明書を註冊課務組（学籍・履修担当）に確認してください。
texts.family: "Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", Meiryo, "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif
"Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", Meiryo, "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif

texts.text: 編入、復学、修業期間延長などで学籍が変わる場合は、兵役情報と徴集延期・予備役召集に関する手続きの要否を生活指導担当に別途確認してください。学籍手続きだけで兵役手続きも完了したと考えないでください。

texts.text: まず生活指導組に困窮が発生した時期、現在最も緊急を要する支出、すでに申請または受給した支援金について説明してください。担当者に適用可能な支援策の判断を依頼し、一つの案内を逃したからといってすべての支援が終わったと思い込まないようにしましょう。

texts.text: 担当者が案内した支援策に従い、申請書、在学証明書、医療や失業の証明など、事情に関する書類を準備してください。所得・財産・戸籍に関する資料が必要か、どの形式が必要かも先に確認してから取り寄せましょう。

"Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", Meiryo, "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif

texts.text: 書類提出前に、個人で直接提出するのか大学が一括手続きを行うのかを確認し、申請期限と再提出・追完の方法を明確にしておいてください。氏名や振込口座情報が正しいかも再確認しましょう。支援策によって期限が異なるため、他の案内の日程を流用しないでください。
